attempts.certificate: 新字母序为 x < l < g < a < b < c < d < e < f < h < i < j < k < m < n < o < p < q < r < s < t < u < v < w < y < z；按降序先比较首字母，x 开头的词排在 l、g、z、y 开头的词之前。xenon 与 xeme 的第二字母同为 e，第三字母 n > e，因此 xenon 在前；linden 与 ledger 的第二字母 i > e，因此 linden 在前。前四个为 xenon, xeme, linden, ledger。

judges.reason: The custom ascending order places x, then l, then g at the top, so descending lexicographic order begins with x-starting words, followed by l-starting words. Within the x group, xenon precedes xeme because n ranks after m in the custom order; within the l group, linden precedes ledger because i ranks after e. Thus the canonical first four are correct.
judges.depth_evidence: The solution requires constructing the modified alphabet, applying descending first-letter grouping, and resolving two within-group lexicographic comparisons using the modified order.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate correctly identifies the first-letter groups and the l-group comparison, and reaches the correct answer. It has a minor factual slip: xenon and xeme share only their second letter e, not their third letter; their third letters are n and m. The ordering conclusion remains correct.
